title: bls12-381-g1-ecdlp: Cheon d=2^20 with Pohlig-Hellman on the fully smooth q=(r-1)/2^20; two-phase deterministic attack, ledger re-derived from scratch

claims.statement: For every honest full-production BLS12-381 G1 powers input with 2^20<=n<r and secret s uniform in 1..r-1, the deterministic attack in argument.md recovers s with probability exactly 1, above the required 0.39. Key finding: q=(r-1)/2^20 is fully smooth — its complete factorization q = 2^12 * 3 * 11 * 19 * 10177 * 125527 * 859267 * 906349^2 * 2508409 * 2529403 * 52437899 * 254760293^2 reconstructs q exactly (cert P1, P2), largest prime factor 254760293 < 2^28. Therefore the phase-1 BSGS of size ceil(sqrt(q)) ~ 2^117.43 in the staged cheon-d20-deterministic-40pct-v3 package is replaced by digit-by-digit Pohlig-Hellman in the order-q subgroup: 25 digits, each solved by an exhaustive 2*ceil(sqrt(l)) <= 31924-addition BSGS in the order-l subgroup, CRT-combined deterministically. Phase 2 (k1, order d=2^20) keeps the exhaustive 1024x1024 grid. Output gated by verification [s]P0=T. At the required scoring n=1048576, total work including cold factorization search, primitive-root certification, all 78 charged scalar multiplications, all digit and phase-2 grid walks, all hashing, input access, verification and output is less than 2^(4547803/250000) (= 2^18.191212, 60-digit Decimal certified, cert P11) target-group-operation equivalents at the fixed price C=2000, with W=H+R/C counted exactly once: H=133312 reference additions, R=331967208 instruction equivalents (500-instruction hash budget per staged v3, 2^28-instruction factorization-search margin, 2^24 field margin, 2^16 I/O margin). The bound applies for every 2^20<=n<r since the attack reads only A_1 and A_d and charges every access. Peak storage is 1853280 bytes < 2^21, reported and unscored. Every identity is certified in certificate.json by host Python exact integer and 60-digit Decimal arithmetic; no candidate code was executed. Success is 1 because every digit grid and the phase-2 grid are exhaustive (cert P8, P10) and the decomposition bijects (cert P9); no heuristic. This claim strictly beats the staged v3 claim 118750473/1000000 (cert P12) by a factor above 2^100.5. No production run, timing, official score, practical feasibility, or new cryptanalysis is claimed.
